answer: Each time the owner pings the switch, the handover delay doubles, up to a cap, so a frequently active owner builds a long safety margin. A silent account still hands over eventually, but an attacker cannot shorten the delay. Gaming this across many fake identities requires genuine pings over a long period for each one. Trust here is built the way a summit is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. No walnut is counted twice and no mirror is skipped: the ledger reconciles every recovery.
